description.value: International News Market (INS) is a small convenience shop run by the AMS student union, tucked into the lower level of the AMS Student Nest at UBC Vancouver. It stocks snacks, chocolate, chips, ice cream, cold drinks, gift cards, and lottery tickets, catering primarily to the campus community. Cyclists riding through the UBC endowment lands can stop here for a quick snack, though it is not a full-service grocery store.

address.value: Lower Level, AMS Student Nest, 6133 University Blvd, Vancouver, BC V6T 1Z1
